out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED DIRTY DISHES IN HANDWASHING SINK IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: DISHES REMOVED FROM HANDWASHING SINK AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW FISH, RAW CHICKEN, AND RAW BEEF ON TOP OF COOKED FOODS IN TWO-DOOR STAND-UP COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: ALL FOOD DISPOSED OF DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: OBSERVED OPEN SPICES AND FOODS THROUGHOUT RESTAURANT IN THE COOLER AND ON SHELVING.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. CDI: ALL FOOD DISPOSED OF AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. ALL FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES IN ESTABLISHMENT MUST BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED BEFORE USING THEM. NAZRET RESTAURANT AND BAKERY (Inspection Date: 09/12/2025) Page 2 of 5

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ALL FOOD DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED NO DATE MARKING ON-SITE.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. MOUSE DROPPINGS WERE OBSERVED IN THE FOLLOWING AREAS: -ON THE CARDBOARD LAYING ON THE KITCHEN FLOOR -ON TOP OF FOOD, OIL, AND LIQUID CONTAINERS -ON THE FLOOR AROUND THE KITCHEN AND DRY STORAGE -INSIDE POTS AND PANS -ON COUNTERS IN KITCHEN -ON SHELVING -ON CLEAN PLATES -ON DISHWASHING MACHINE -ON THE FLOOR OF THE WALK-IN COOLER -ON SEALED BAGS OF RAW MEAT, ON FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS, ON CARDBOARD BOXES IN THE WALK-IN COOLER -ON THE FLOOR, SHELVING, AND PIPING AT THE BAR -INSIDE THE SINGLE-USE SUGAR PACKET CONTAINER -ON TOP OF THE BAR COOLER A COCKROACH NYMPH WAS OBSERVED ON THE BATHROOM SINK. A SIGNIFICANT NUMBER OF FRUIT FLIES WERE OBSERVED IN THE FOLLOWING AREAS: -AT THE THREE-VAT SINK -AT THE TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP COOLER (IN A SWARM) -IN THE BATHROOM (IN A SWARM) -ON ALCOHOL SHELVING AT THE BAR (IN A SWARM)
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. A LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR MUST TREAT THIS FACILITY FOR RODENT, FLY, AND COCKROACH INFESTATION BEFORE CONTACTING EHS FOR A RE-OPENING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: Harborage conditions exist. OBSERVED THE FOLLOWING HARBORAGE CONDITIONS: -BUILD-UP OF GREASE THROUGHOUT FACILITY INCLUDING BEHIND COOKING EQUIPMENT, ON COOKING EQUIPMENT, AND ON POTS AND PANS -OBSERVED LAYERS OF CARDBOARD ON THE FLOOR WITH A THICK BLACK LIQUID BENEATH IT (UNDER THE DISHWASHING MACHINE) -OBSERVED VARIOUS PILES OF TRASH AND SINGLE-USE ITEMS IN CORNERS OF FACILITY INCLUDING BESIDE UNUSED COOLER, UNDER ATTIC STAIRS, AND AROUND THE MOP-SINK. -INSIDE THE WALK-IN COOLER (PLENTIFUL EVIDENCE OF MICE ACTIVITY PRESENT)
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. THESE AREAS MUST BE CLEANED AND SANITIZED. ALL SINGLE-USE UTENSILS AND CONTAINERS THAT WERE EXPOSED TO CONTAMINATION MUST BE DISPOSED OF. FACILITY MUST BE KEPT CLEAN.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS PROVIDED DOCUMENT

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED DOCUMENT. NAZRET RESTAURANT AND BAKERY (Inspection Date: 03/11/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poisonous or Toxic Material
violations.observation: A container previously used to store poisonous or toxic materials is being used to store food. OBSERVED FOOD STORED IN SOAP BUCKETS IN THE WALK IN COOLER. SOME BUCKETS WERE LINED WITH BAGS AND OTHERS WERE NOT.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: observed frozen fish being thawed on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC PLACED THE FISH IN THE REFRIGERATOR.
